speaker: A3PL7JEMIPFHI9
text: Hello. How are you today?

speaker: A2CSV75E3JT58Y
text: Doing pretty well, thanks.

speaker: A3PL7JEMIPFHI9
text: Glad to hear it. Are you someone who has ever donated to a charity or offered your time for a charitable cause?

speaker: A2CSV75E3JT58Y
text: Yes. I have done both.

speaker: A3PL7JEMIPFHI9
text: I'm glad to hear that. Charity is very important. Can I ask what kind of organizations you have donated to?

speaker: A2CSV75E3JT58Y
text: A variety ... mostly health related causes.

speaker: A3PL7JEMIPFHI9
text: Those are very good causes. Have you ever heard of the organization Save the Children?

speaker: A2CSV75E3JT58Y
text: Yes but I don't know much about it.

speaker: A3PL7JEMIPFHI9
text: Save the Children Promotes children's rights, provides relief, and helps support children in developing countries. They work in the US and internationally.

speaker: A2CSV75E3JT58Y
text: That sounds like a very worthy cause.

speaker: A3PL7JEMIPFHI9
text: It is. More impressively, 86% of all expenditures go to program services so donations are used for the cause rather than allocated to profits.

speaker: A2CSV75E3JT58Y
text: That is pretty impressive but I would rather see more than 90 percent of donations go directly to helping the children.

speaker: A3PL7JEMIPFHI9
text: I can understand that. But given that it is an international organization, there is overhead that must be paid for such as travel. This organization is especially helpful in countries where there is a lack of support for children in war zones such as Syria.

speaker: A2CSV75E3JT58Y
text: I know international travel is expensive but having 14 percent of the donations going to overhead seems a bit high to me.  It should be no more than 10 percent max.

speaker: A3PL7JEMIPFHI9
text: I understand. But many organization are too scared to go into countries like Syria where children are facing extreme violence. In the first 2 months alone, 1,000 children were killed or injured there. Save the Children does help in this country and others like it.

speaker: A2CSV75E3JT58Y
text: I can understand that but I have seen too many examples of charities where the money is not spent wisely.

speaker: A3PL7JEMIPFHI9
text: I can see your concern, but please know that this is a very worthy cause. How much do you like to donate to the charity now? Your donation will be directly deducted from your task payment. You can choose any amount from $0 to all your payment ($2).

speaker: A2CSV75E3JT58Y
text: I would say 40 cents

speaker: A3PL7JEMIPFHI9
text: Thank you so much for your generosity. It will be put to very good use.

speaker: A2CSV75E3JT58Y
text: okay.
